title: WikiPulse page change event v1
description: Validated, pseudonymised page change produced by the ingest service to Kafka topic wikipulse.page_change.v1. Message key is "<wiki_id>:<page_id>" so all changes to one page are ordered within one partition. Headers: upstream_schema, sse_position. Contains no user names, user IDs, IP addresses or edit comments.

event_id.description: Upstream meta.id. Deduplication and idempotency key.

event_dt.description: Upstream dt (UTC). Event time for all windows.

ingested_at.description: Time the ingest service received the event (UTC).

sse_position.description: Opaque EventStreams Last-Event-ID JSON array at which this event was received.

page_title.description: Title after the change, without namespace prefix, underscores for spaces.

prior_page_title.description: Title before a move; null for other change kinds.

rev_sha1.description: Base-36 SHA-1 of revision content as published by MediaWiki.

revert.description: Present when MediaWiki identified this revision as a revert.

editor_type.description: bot: performer in a bot group; temp: temporary account; anonymous_ip: logged-out edit attributed to an IP; system: MediaWiki maintenance actor; registered: everyone else.

editor_key.description: HMAC-SHA256 over "<wiki_id>:<user_id>" (fallback "<wiki_id>:<user_text>" when user_id is absent) under a secret key, truncated to 16 bytes and hex-encoded. Used only for distinct counts. Null for system actors.
